    Overview
    Specs
    Reviews (62)
    You can immerse yourself in the world of gaming with the TUF Gaming VG27AQ3A, a 27-inch QHD gaming monitor. This high-performance monitor boasts a Fast IPS panel, delivering a blistering 180Hz refresh rate for ultra-smooth, lag-free gaming. With ASUS Extreme Low Motion Blur Sync (ELMB Sync), AMD FreeSync Premium, and G-SYNC compatibility, this monitor ensures seamless visuals and low latency, enhancing your gaming experience. The VG27AQ3A monitor supports HDR and offers a 130% sRGB gamut, providing exceptional color accuracy and contrast. Whether you're playing first-person shooters, real-time strategy games, or sports titles, the 180Hz refresh rate and 1ms (GTG) response time give you the edge, allowing you to react instantly to on-screen action.

    The monitor's Adaptive-Sync technology, including AMD FreeSync Premium, NVIDIA G-Sync compatibility, and VESA AdaptiveSync, ensures super-smooth, tear-free visuals. With ASUS Variable Overdrive technology, the monitor dynamically adjusts its overdrive setting as frame rates fluctify, delivering optimal results for any game. The TUF Gaming VG27AQ3A also features ELMB Sync software, which works in tandem with adaptive-sync technology to eliminate ghosting and tearing, resulting in extraordinarily sharp, high-frame-rate gaming. For enhanced in-game visuals, the monitor offers ASUS Shadow Boost technology, which clarifies dark areas of the game without overexposing brighter areas.

    This feature not only improves overall viewing but also makes it easier to spot enemies hidden in dark areas of the map. The ASUS-exclusive GamePlus hotkey offers in-game enhancements, developed with input from pro gamers, to help you improve your gaming skills. Additionally, ASUS GameVisual Technology provides seven pre-set display modes to optimize visuals for different types of content. The TUF Gaming VG27AQ3A is designed with your comfort in mind. Its Flicker-Free technology reduces flicker to minimize eyestrain during long gaming sessions, while ASUS Low Blue Light technology reduces the amount of potentially harmful blue light emitted by the display.

    The monitor offers extensive connectivity options, including two HDMI 2.0 ports and a DisplayPort 1.4, ensuring compatibility with a variety of input sources. The ergonomically-designed stand allows for tilt and swivel adjustments, helping you find your ideal viewing position. Plus, the display is VESA-compatible for wall mounting, offering flexibility in setup.
